main.description: What this appview offers the clients that use it: the runners a new public repository names unless its owner names others, the oldest client version it asks for, and the oldest iOS build it lets run. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

client.description: The oldest version of knotless's client the appview asks clients to be, set when an older one harms what it touches. A client older than it refuses to run, but to upgrade, until it is upgraded. The newest release is at the appview's /releases/latest.
